info.name: CodePulse API
info.description:
Comprehensive API test suite for the CodePulse backend.

Folders:
- Health Check: Service availability
- Auth Errors: Authentication failure scenarios
- Validation Errors: Request validation (requires auth_token)
- Happy Path: Successful analysis scenarios (requires auth_token + live services)
- Account CRUD: Account management endpoints (requires auth_token + live Supabase)
- Submission CRUD: Submission management endpoints (requires auth_token + live services)
